title: Space used during copying
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}$ be distinct indices among the $k$ work tapes. For any family $w$ of Boolean words on those tapes with empty destination word, and for every time $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the copying machine started in its sweep state with tape contents $w$ has visited at most $|w_{\mathrm{src}}|+2$ distinct cells on each of the source and destination tapes by time $t$. Every other tape has visited exactly one distinct cell by time $t$.
